=INSERT INTO publications (source_type, source_raw, source_sender, source_subject, source_text, source_media, status)
VALUES (
  'email',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Webhook Email').item.json.body).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ String($json.sender).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.subject).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.text).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.media).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  'pending'
)
RETURNING id;
